description: LinkedIn posts API for AI agents: send one LinkedIn profile or company page URL and get its recent posts as JSON, each with text, date, likes, comments, shares, author, post URL and the reposter when it is a repost. Up to 20 posts per call; pay per post in stablecoins. A URL with no posts is not charged.

limit.description: number of posts wanted, 1 to 20 (default 5). A larger value is lowered to 20 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

url.description: LinkedIn profile URL (https://www.linkedin.com/in/<name>/) or company page URL (https://www.linkedin.com/company/<name>/); one URL per call

name: linkedin-posts
title: LinkedIn posts of a profile or company
